settings.heading: Built for the hours after dark
settings.body:
Noctairre began with one idea: a garment heavy enough to feel like armour and quiet enough to disappear into a night street.

Every piece is cut oversized, garment-dyed, then washed until the black breaks. Nothing is printed loudly. The marks we do use — 夜, 黒波, 空 — are stitched small, meant to be found rather than shown.

We make in small runs. When a size sells out it usually stays sold out.

settings.heading: Heavyweight only
settings.body: 480gsm loopback cotton, garment-dyed and washed until it moves like something you have owned for years.

settings.heading: Small runs
settings.body: Each piece is cut in limited quantities. We do not restock — a sold size stays sold.

settings.heading: One colour
settings.body: Everything is black. Washed, faded, distressed — but always black. The silhouette does the talking.
